# JustSketchMe

> > JustSketchMe is a web-based character posing and pose reference tool designed for artists to create dynamic character sketches and reference materials.

JustSketchMe provides artists with an intuitive platform for posing 3D character models, generating pose references, and accessing a library of hand poses and dynamic lighting options. The tool is available as a free tier with Pro subscription options, and is built for web with cross-platform accessibility.
